title: How to be beautiful forever - a note from living gently in the forest
en: whenever i meet a person i often notice their eyes i particularly love those little wrinkles that form around them when they smile i enjoy when someone shares a topic they're passionate about their face has a way of lighting up and the vibrancy is in their voice when someone is kind they shine a light that makes others feel as if the world is a little better than a minute before so i know what it is to have no self-esteem

and when i was able to finally crawl out of that hole and find that stability in regards to how i see myself i was surprised that being comfortable wasn't necessarily being confident in how i looked it was simply being at peace with who i was to give a very silly example i'm told quite often online that i have an unfortunately large nose it comes with the territory of being someone on the internet these comments are often attempting to make me feel self-conscious but i'm happy to say it doesn't because it relies on me agreeing with their perception and internalizing it and that is where my power lies and yours does too indeed words become real only if you believe they are
when you get to that place it's incredible to feel that freedom and all time spent critiquing my own or others external selves seems like a waste of potential my life minutes could be used in so many

other wondrous ways i asked all of you what made a person beautiful and without fail i got the words of compassion and honesty and that's interesting because in a way those are some of the easiest things to be it may be hard at the very start when we have layers of fear and hurt in our way but once those walls come down we're free and just like that we become something so beautiful it cannot be described through a physical representation we can spend the rest of time debating

physical beauty but i would really like to spend that time wondering how i can cultivate a beauty that lasts forever i think that's a far more interesting question i have been working on this little bunny

rabbit all morning and i have to say it has filled me with so much joy i am always surprised by the little things that bring me little moments of just happiness throughout the day and this is one of them i think getting creative and making something um you know that isn't necessarily very complicated or anything but just something that brings you joy it's so beautiful and i think so important on a daily basis you know if it's possible depending on the person you know there are different things that may bring you joy i know for a lot of people it's coffee for some people it may be their pets you know laying in bed after a long day of work

cupcakes and cookies for me today what brings me joy is painting a little bunny with a mushroom cap because it's so simple but something about it just making my day so metimes it's just simplest most sometimes it's just simplest most darling little things that make all the difference
zh: 每当我遇到一个人时，我经常注意到他们的眼睛，我特别喜欢他们微笑时在他们周围形成的那些小皱纹，我喜欢有人分享他们热衷的话题，他们的脸有一种发光的方式，他们的声音充满活力，当有人友善时，他们发出光芒，让别人感觉世界比一分钟前好一点，所以我知道什么是没有自尊
当我最终能够爬出那个洞并发现我如何看待自己时，我很惊讶，舒适并不一定对我的外表充满信心，这只是与我要的人保持和平。举一个非常愚蠢的例子，我经常在网上被告知，我有一个不幸的大鼻子，它伴随着成为互联网上的某个人的领域这些评论经常试图让我感到不自在，但我很高兴地说事实并非如此，因为它依赖于我同意他们的看法并内化这就是我的力量所在，也是你的力量所在。事实上，只有当你相信它们是真实的时，言语才会成为现实。
当你到达那个地方时，你会感到难以置信，那种自由和所有时间花在批评自己或其他外在自我上似乎是在浪费潜力，我的生命时间可以用在很多事情上。
我问你们所有人什么让一个人变得美丽，毫无疑问，我得到了同情和诚实的话语，这很有趣，因为在某种程度上，这些是一些最容易的事情，一开始可能会很困难，因为我们有层层恐惧和伤害挡在我们的道路上，但一旦这些墙倒塌，我们就自由了，就像我们变得如此美丽，无法通过物理表征来描述，我们可以花剩下的时间辩论
身体之美，但我真的很想花时间思考如何才能培养出永恒的美丽，我认为这是一个更有趣的问题，我一直在研究这只小兔子
整个早上我不得不说它让我充满了快乐，我总是对那些给我带来快乐的小事情感到惊讶，这就是其中之一，我认为发挥创意并制作一些东西，嗯，你知道，这不一定很复杂，或者什么，但只是给你带来快乐的东西，它是如此美丽，我认为每天都很重要，你知道是否有可能，取决于你认识的人，有不同的东西可以给你带来快乐，我知道对很多人来说，这就是咖啡人们，可能是他们的宠物，您认识的人在结束一整天的工作后躺在床上
今天给我做纸杯蛋糕和饼干，给我带来快乐的是画一只戴着蘑菇帽的小兔子，因为它很简单，但它让我的一天很开心，所以有时它只是最简单的，有时它只是最简单的，最可爱的小东西，让一切变得不同
